meta.audience: Someone installing AI Handout Studio for the first time

head.title: Setup and usage
head.lede: Ask your agent and it installs: type /studio-setup in Claude Code, or ask Codex CLI "Set this up by following SETUP.md." This page covers what happens then and how to use it afterwards.

summary.label: Summary
summary.text: In the cloned repository, ask your agent. doctor checks the state and names the next section; your agent works through it. You only answer four things: language, organization name, the agent instructions block and the optional features. After that, ask "make a handout about ..." from a chat in any folder.

props.text: You need the following. If something is missing, your agent shows how to install it in the matching section.

rows: macOS or Linux. On Windows, use it inside WSL
Node 24 or later and pnpm 11. With mise, mise install sets both

items.text: Clone the repository and start your agent in that folder.
In Claude Code, type /studio-setup. In Codex CLI, ask: "Set this up by following SETUP.md."
items.why: For the Japanese steps, point it at SETUP.ja.md.

items.text: Your agent runs doctor and reads the section in next.section.
It follows that section and runs doctor again.
items.why: It repeats until ok is true.

props.caption: Works even before pnpm install. After section 5, ai-handout-studio doctor --json does the same

props.label: What you are asked
props.text: Your agent only asks about choices: language, organization name, adding the agent instructions block and the optional features. It asks before editing your agent instructions or shell settings. It never uses sudo; when that is needed, it shows the command for you to run.

rows: Match versions with mise install or corepack
Symlink them into the skills folders
Show it and let you add or decline it
Ask all three in one question sheet

props.text: In section 9 you are asked, in one question sheet, whether to use these three. Use the same command to change them later.

rows: Read handouts on a phone on the same Wi-Fi
Anyone on the network can read them. Skip it on shared Wi-Fi
Make illustrations with an image CLI (Codex CLI or Antigravity CLI)
Share question sheets and HTML documents as a Claude Artifact
With a public link, anyone can read the names in the handout

items.text: From a chat in any folder, ask "make a handout about ...".
items.why: What you ask decides whether it becomes slides, an HTML document or a question sheet.

items.text: If something is missing, a question sheet URL arrives first.
items.why: Answer it, press "Copy answers" and paste into the chat.

items.text: Your agent makes it, runs the check and returns the URL.
items.why: It also shows up in the app's handout list.

items.text: Fix wording or layout on screen, then export or share.

props.alt: The intake question sheet asking about the reader, length, screenshots and title
props.caption: The intake question sheet

props.alt: The slide list with three cover cards; the left menu has sections for slides, question sheets and HTML documents
props.caption: The handout list (slides). Click a card to open the editor

props.text: To open the app yourself, run ai-handout-studio open in a terminal and open the url it prints. Help in the left menu explains each screen.

To update, pull and follow doctor. If it says the agent instructions block is outdated, replace it in section 8 (with your consent). If the server code changed, restart it with ai-handout-studio restart.

git pull
pnpm install
node scripts/doctor.mjs --json
props.caption: Updating

items.text: Remove the skill links (only the links).
Delete the ai-handout-studio block (between its markers) from your agent instructions.
Before deleting the clone, decide whether to keep workspace/.

props.text: workspace/ holds your handouts and question-sheet answers. Deleting the clone with it cannot be undone.

rows: Find the owner with lsof -nP -iTCP:5190 -sTCP:LISTEN. If it is not ai-handout-studio, decide whether to stop it
Run sudo pnpm exec playwright install-deps chromium
Check the phone is on the same Wi-Fi (guest networks often isolate devices), the app is open to the LAN (features.lan), and the firewall lets node accept connections
Open ai-handout-studio-dev.log in the system temp folder
You deleted this page and the usage slides
Run ai-handout-studio examples to add them again (--lang ja or en picks the language)

glossary.description: A command that checks the setup and names the next SETUP section to read
Instructions your agent reads. Two are installed: handouts and question sheets
The file your agent reads in every folder (such as ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md)
The folder for handouts and settings. It is outside git
